title_i18n.es: La trampa de un solo paso (en la investigación en IA)

excerpt_i18n.en: The article highlights the 'one-step trap' in AI research, where focusing too much on immediate rewards hinders long-term intelligent behavior.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 该文指出AI研究中常见的“一步陷阱”，即研究者倾向于优化即时回报而忽略长期目标，这限制了智能系统的长远发展。

items.title: Apple’s failed self-driving car program left a legacy of powerful AI chips
items.raw_excerpt: Apple's self-driving car program never really got off the ground, but it may have been what made the company's chips the powerful AI performers they are.
